item.title: Amplicon-Based Sequencing Aids Severe Pneumonia Diagnosis
item.description: Amplicon-based sequencing may boost severe pneumonia diagnosis in ICU, particularly for fungal infections and immunosuppressed patients. The post Amplicon-Based Sequencing Aids Severe Pneumonia Diagnosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Real World Multiple Myeloma Outcomes Across Treatment Lines
item.description: A large English registry analysis shows survival in multiple myeloma declines with each treatment line and is significantly longer in patients receiving autologous stem cell transplant. The post Real World Multiple Myeloma Outcomes Across Treatment Lines appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Atypical Depression Shows Distinct Genetic and Treatment Profile
item.description: Using polygenic score analyses, researchers found that atypical depression was associated with higher genetic risk for several psychiatric traits... The post Atypical Depression Shows Distinct Genetic and Treatment Profile appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Netherlands Data Highlight Treatment Patterns and Recurrence Risk in Lentigo Maligna
item.description: A nationwide Dutch study reports treatment patterns, upstaging rates, and long-term recurrence outcomes in patients with lentigo maligna. The post Netherlands Data Highlight Treatment Patterns and Recurrence Risk in Lentigo Maligna appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: US government negotiates Medicare part B drugs
item.description: The CMS has unveiled the 15 high-cost medications selected for the next phase of the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program. The post US government negotiates Medicare part B drugs appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Inspiratory Muscle Training Strengthens Diaphragm Function After Stroke
item.description: Inspiratory muscle training strengthened diaphragm measures, and inspiratory strength in subacute stroke participants in six weeks. The post Inspiratory Muscle Training Strengthens Diaphragm Function After Stroke appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Smoking Cessation in Lung Cancer Screening Pays
item.description: In lung cancer screening eight-session counseling with short-course nicotine replacement therapy delivered the best value per quit. The post Smoking Cessation in Lung Cancer Screening Pays appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Physicians Differ on Chronic Urticaria Prevalence
item.description: Worldwide survey shows chronic urticaria prevalence estimates differ, and physicians may underestimate sleep, activity, and impact. The post Physicians Differ on Chronic Urticaria Prevalence appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cardiovascular Disease Increases Mental Health Risk
item.description: Those with ASCVD were more likely to experience somatic symptoms (OR 1.138; 95% CI 1.069–1.212), anxiety and insomnia (OR 1.113; 95% CI 1.043–1.188), and severe depression (OR 1.173; 95% CI 1.084–1.269). The post Cardiovascular Disease Increases Mental Health Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Combines Imaging Data to Predict Stroke Mortality
item.description: AI-derived radiology phenotypes improved stroke mortality prediction, when added to structured EHR data in acute stroke admissions. The post AI Combines Imaging Data to Predict Stroke Mortality appeared first on European Medical Journal.
